note: Each clause is mapped to a test that exists in the repository or declared with the physical evidence it needs. Presentation seams are asserted rather than view source: a grep for .accessibilityLabel proves a modifier exists and nothing about what it says. Where a seam could be bypassed by a view that stops calling it, the clause also names the wiring: the file and the exact application, read from source the way tests/contract reads the router. A seam nothing calls is not coverage.

Focus order follows visual order..note: The declared order is asserted against the card's visual order. Whether VoiceOver honours it on a real screen is the physical run below.

VoiceOver rotor and reading order.reason: VoiceOver is a system service and cannot be driven from a unit test.
VoiceOver rotor and reading order.evidence_command: On iPhone, iPad and Mac, turn VoiceOver on and traverse Add Spark, Fleet, Models, Chat and the support-bundle sheet with the rotor.
VoiceOver rotor and reading order.expected_evidence: Every control is reachable and announced with its resource and action, the reading order matches the visual order, and no element announces only its type.

Dynamic Type at the largest accessibilit.reason: Layout under a real text size needs a real screen.
Dynamic Type at the largest accessibilit.evidence_command: Set Larger Accessibility Sizes to maximum and open every primary screen on iPhone and iPad.
Dynamic Type at the largest accessibilit.expected_evidence: No copy truncates, no control becomes unreachable, and headers stack rather than compress.

Contrast.reason: Needs the system Increase Contrast setting and a measured ratio.
Contrast.evidence_command: Enable Increase Contrast and measure the foreground/background ratio of every status colour and its text.
Contrast.expected_evidence: Every pairing meets WCAG AA, and every state remains distinguishable with colour filters on.

Keyboard-only navigation.reason: Needs a hardware keyboard on iPad and Mac.
Keyboard-only navigation.evidence_command: With a hardware keyboard only, complete Add Spark, start a model, and export a support bundle.
Keyboard-only navigation.expected_evidence: Every step is reachable by Tab and arrow keys, focus is always visible, and no action requires a pointer.
